name: ZessTech Login Branding
author: Zess Tech

sections.description:
Custom Login Branding allows you to replace the default WordPress login logo and footer text with your own.
You can also optionally display “Powered by Zess Tech” or a link to SEO services, but these are disabled by default.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/custom-login-branding/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Login Branding to configure.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin add backlinks automatically?

No. All branding options are optional and disabled by default.

Can I use my own logo?

Yes. You can enter your logo URL in the settings page.

short_description: Customize the WordPress login page with your own logo, footer text, and optional branding. Simple, lightweight, and translation-ready.
